quarterly_data.quarter: Roche-Genentech press release: Roche's Lunsumio-based regimen significantly improves (09-17-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: The phase III CELESTIMO study of Lunsumio (mosunetuzumab) plus lenalidomide versus rituximab plus lenalidomide in relapsed or refractory follicular lymphoma after at least one prior line met its primary endpoint at the interim analysis, with a statistically significant and clinically meaningful improvement in progression-free survival (no effect size disclosed); overall survival data were immature, and no new safety signals were identified. Data will be submitted to health authorities. CELESTIMO is the confirmatory study required to convert Lunsumio monotherapy's accelerated approval / conditional marketing authorisation in third-line or later FL to full approval and to secure a second-line or later FL indication. Lunsumio is approved for 3L+ FL in 60 countries and has treated over 3,800 patients. The U.S. FDA recently accepted the sBLA for Lunsumio plus Polivy in 2L+ DLBCL (SUNMO study); the phase III MorningLyte study in first-line FL is ongoing.
quarterly_data.figure: phase III CELESTIMO met PFS primary endpoint at interim; approved in 60 countries; over 3,800 patients treated
